title: LIVE WATER CLARITY / TURBIDITY
source_name: NOAA CoastWatch S-NPP VIIRS Kd(PAR) diffuse attenuation, Science Quality, Global 4 km, Daily (ERDDAP nesdisVHNSQkdparDaily), legacy NRT id as fallback
variable: kd_par (Diffuse Attenuation Coefficient for PAR; NOAA MECB algorithm; product status Experimental)
direction: larger values mean MORE turbid water (more attenuation); clear water sits at the blue/cyan end
what: Diffuse attenuation coefficient for photosynthetically available radiation (KdPAR): how quickly sunlight fades with depth. Larger values mean more turbid water; smaller values mean clearer water. Source values are never altered for color convenience.
why_extreme: Rare very-turbid water (storm resuspension, river plumes, intense blooms) compresses into red-violet/deep-purple; ordinary clear conditions own most of the color resolution.
